svg.desc: The left panel evaluates a one-parameter squared-error objective against nine synthetic perturbed observations; the minimum selects a rate near 0.4 per minute. The right panel shows remaining temperature residuals. An optimizer success flag does not validate the physical cooling assumptions or identify measurement uncertainty.
svg.title: Optional parameter fit and residuals
